summary: All three features (wand-aimed casting, broom-gated flight with v1/v2/v3 save migration, and the world map overlay) are implemented faithfully to the approved design, and the full gate (typecheck, 106 tests, lint, build) passes clean. No HIGH or MEDIUM findings.

findings.detail: Notification body reads 'Press ${key} to summon your broom.' vs the design's 'Press ${key} to summon it.' — a harmless wording variant; the live toggleBroom key is correctly resolved via keyLabel so it survives rebinds. No change required.

MAP_VIEW = WORLD_HALF_SIZE (580) per the design, so the castle grounds occupy a small central region of the map. This matches the spec literally; a future tweak could zoom to the castle extent, but it is out of scope and not a defect.
